senses.gloss: legal permission to a creditor to trace the debtor’s property for the purpose of having it seized, assessed, offered for public sale, and eventually delivered to him. [Order of documents, acc. to B. Bath. 169ᵃ, vers. of Maim. a. others: 1) אדרכתא;
<cite ref="I00453"><he>טירפא</he></cite> the right of seizure of the debtor’s property sold after the date of the loan (mortgage);

<cite ref="U00440"><he>שומא</he></cite> record of the assessed value for which the creditor took possession;—acc. to vers. in ed. a. Mss. 1) <cite ref="I00453"><he>טירפא</he></cite> right of seizure &c.; 2) <he>א׳</he> authorization to seize the traced property, defining position &c.; 3) <cite ref="U00440"><he>שומא</he></cite>.] <cite ref="Bava Batra 169a:5">B. Bath. 169ᵃ</cite>.
units: Keth. 104ᵇ. 2) private authorization to collect or take possession of one’s debtordeposit; assignment, transfer.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 70a">B. Kam. 70ᵃ</cite> Ms. M., At. (ed. <he>אור׳</he>); <cite ref="Shevuot 33b">Shebu. 33ᵇ</cite> (ed. <he>אור׳</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.); <cite ref="Bekhorot 49a:2">Bekh. 49ᵃ</cite>
